verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships an official TypeScript Plugin API (obsidian-api on GitHub) and developer docs for building plugins/themes, plus a headless Sync client noted as useful for CI pipelines and agents — enough for a developer to build against official interfaces. But there is no dedicated AI/agent SDK, no official REST/HTTP API for external automation, and plugins run only inside the Obsidian app with full filesystem access (no sandboxing), limiting agentic/headless use cases. missing for 10: dedicated AI-agent SDK, official external REST/HTTP API, sandboxed/headless execution model for agents.
